Include all requested counts and provenance fields. Explain the query result in ordinary prose; do not emit placeholder text. These questions concern a static map of open-source Python code. After executing SQL, describe the returned rows and query assumptions. Questions asking which files, modules or symbols mean distinct identities, not one repeated row per matching import or call occurrence; preserve occurrence counts only when requested. Use files.is_test for test-file classification; test_links describe associations, not the complete set of test files. Use DOUBLE or DECIMAL, rather than single-precision REAL, for percentage calculations.
Return each package and its total line count. Order by lines descending, then package ascending.

gold_sql:
SELECT package, SUM(line_count) AS lines
FROM code.files
WHERE package LIKE 'auto_ontology%' AND NOT is_test
GROUP BY package
ORDER BY lines DESC, package
LIMIT 5;
